protocol.signal: first trading session each month at close; execute next trading session open
protocol.score: cached V1 ensemble cross-sectional ordinal rank
protocol.momentum: adjusted close(T)/adjusted close(T-60 sessions)-1 ordinal rank
protocol.primary_rule: equal weight of score and 60-session momentum ranks; Top2, equal weight
protocol.execution: same audited cash ledger; 100-share lots, capacity, limit locks, fees and slippage

audit.matching_method: previous execution-day shares x previous-close-to-current-open adjusted return / previous equity; compounded without fees
